extraction_scope: Worker-6 bounded mechanism adjudication from primary figure captions and supplementary methods; worker-5 was not reassigned.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: KR-12, KR-12(R2, R6), and KR-12(Q5, D9) in E. coli assays
mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports a bacterial membrane-perturbation mechanism for selected KR-12 derivatives using outer-membrane NPN uptake, inner-membrane ONPG permeability, membrane-potential DiSC3-5 depolarization, SEM morphology, and SYTO9/PI live-dead imaging.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is bounded to E. coli membrane assays and does not establish a single molecular protein target.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: KR-12(Q5, D9) in E. coli infected mouse wound model
mechanism_claims.claim_text: The in vivo mouse wound model supports therapeutic antibacterial and wound-healing efficacy for KR-12(Q5, D9), including wound-area, CFU, histology, re-epithelialization, dermal-gap, and collagen-deposition readouts.
mechanism_claims.limitations: These are in vivo efficacy and histology endpoints, not direct molecular target assays.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: LL-37 and KR-12(Q5, D9) anti-inflammatory/LPS assays
mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports LPS-related anti-inflammatory activity for KR-12(Q5, D9) using wound-tissue IL-6/TNF-alpha measurements, RAW264.7 cytokine secretion assays, BC displacement for LPS affinity, and MD models with lipid A.
mechanism_claims.limitations: MD is model evidence; direct experimental support is limited to cytokine and LPS-binding assays.
